sentences.en: I have fibroid tumours. Is there a way to stop them getting large?
sentences.zh: 我有子宫肌瘤。有没有办法阻止它们变大？

sentences.en: The tumour seems to be benign.
sentences.zh: 这个肿瘤似乎是良性的。

sentences.en: Swollen lymph nodes are usually found near the site of an infection, tumour, or inflammation.
sentences.zh: 肿大的淋巴结通常出现在感染、肿瘤或炎症部位附近。
